item.title: The impact of social isolation and psychological distress on overall survival in cancer: A population-based cohort study
item.description: A population-based study of how social isolation and psychological distress relate to overall survival in people with cancer. Accepted at JCO Oncology Practice; a link will be added once the paper is published.
